text: Another important thing is, this is the maximum data rate with which you can transmit your bits, right? That's why it's reported at physical layer data rate because it's the speed at which bits can be transmitted when you are here at the physical layer. Now, what we user actually perceive is something different. Why? Because we user perceive the bit rate at which we can deliver our information. So when you want to upload a picture photo, what you perceive is the actual time that takes for you to transfer all the packets that carry the bits related to that picture. This is something different because this is the speed that you can achieve when you transmit. So conditionally to the fact that you are transmitting, then this is this maximum speed at which your physical layer can send packets. But before transmitting, you need to follow the Mac protocol, the Mac function rules to access the channel. So the time that it takes to deliver your photo.
